image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a brown tabby cat resting on a rough, textured surface (possibly stone or concrete). The cat is looking down and to the right. Its front paws are tucked neatly beneath its chest. The fur shows distinct black stripes on a brownish-grey background, characteristic of a mackerel or spotted tabby pattern. The lighting is natural, casting soft shadows. The background consists of a weathered wall with peeling paint.
